name: Raptive Intelligence
author: Raptive

sections.description:
Raptive Intelligence facilitates access to the Raptive Assistant on eligible public pages on approved sites.

When enabled on an approved site, the plugin adds Raptive’s remote script from Raptive’s production CDN and loads the Raptive Assistant on eligible public pages. The Assistant sends the page URL to request recipe tips and answer visitor questions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings > Raptive Intelligence.
  3. Enable the Assistant and save.
sections.changelog:
0.1.7
